input.behavior_to_protect: When targets is specified, stable_batches must only schedule nodes in the transitive dependency closure of those targets; unreachable nodes must not appear in the output.

description: Write one regression scenario where stable_batches is called with targets=["D"] and D depends on A and B; node C (which D does not depend on) must not appear in the output. The scenario must fail a mutant that schedules all nodes regardless of the targets parameter.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
